about_the_game:
From the creators of RestorArt and Twistingo comes a sun-kissed puzzle escape you won’t want to miss: Jixo 2: Summer Dreams!

Step into a world of easygoing summer bliss. From sunny gardens to peaceful patios, each scene bursts with bright colours, calming details, and the simple joy of a beautiful day in full bloom.

Immerse yourself in a delightful variety of seasonal games, including captivating hidden-object puzzles full of charming discoveries, inventive jigsaw challenges with a fresh twist, and engaging picture puzzles that celebrate the warmth and wonder of the season—all set to soothing, relaxing music.

Tackle the mysterious Locked Boxes for a satisfying brain workout - each one hiding a new surprise just waiting to be uncovered.

This special Collector's Edition release is full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

Collector’s Edition Features:
🧩 Exclusive Mini-Games – Enjoy endless crosswords, vibrant Tile Matching, and a unique twist on Solitaire
🌸 Garden Paradise – Complete levels to grow your perfect summer garden
📷 Stunning Art Gallery – Bask in the glow of summer with a vivid collection of seasonal artwork

Whether you're puzzling on the porch or daydreaming by the beach, Jixo 2: Summer Dreams is the perfect companion for a peaceful, sun-filled escape.
